HEADLINE: ChatGPT Is an Advertising Platform Now. Here’s What That Means for Your Business.

blog.headline: ChatGPT Just Became an Ad Platform. Here’s Why That Changes Everything for Founders.
blog.angle: OpenAI’s move to embed ads in ChatGPT creates tension between monetization and user trust, forcing founders to rethink how they engage audiences without breaking the conversational flow or credibility.

linkedin.headline: The next time you ask ChatGPT for advice, it might be selling you something.
linkedin.angle: AI platforms turning into ad channels shift the rules of engagement, demanding founders balance innovation with preserving trust to stay relevant.

facebook.headline: ChatGPT is no longer just a chatbot—it’s an advertising platform. What does that mean for your business?
facebook.angle: OpenAI’s ad integration in ChatGPT raises the stakes for brands: How do you advertise without alienating users? Is your business ready for this new trust test?

instagram.headline: ChatGPT: From Chatbot to Ad Platform
instagram.angle: When AI conversations carry ads, founders must rethink how to keep user trust while innovating their marketing.

threads.thread_hook: ChatGPT just flipped the script—it’s now an advertising platform, not just a chatbot.
threads.angle: This thread breaks down why founders can’t treat AI ads like traditional ones and how trust becomes the new currency in conversational marketing.

stories.story_question: What happens when ChatGPT starts selling instead of just helping?
stories.angle: Exploring the tension between monetizing AI conversations and maintaining user trust in a new advertising landscape.

images.hook_text: ChatGPT transforms into an advertising platform for businesses.
